title: Save a page
description: No schedule: the pages you send it (Fetch a URL…, or Send to Harvester from the page) saved as files named after their titles, as PDF by default: receipts, order confirmations, articles that exist only as a web page.

name.title: Name
name.description: For the folder and the tag.

format.title: Saved as
format.description: PDF: the page as printed; HTML: the page with its pictures in one file; Markdown: its main text.
